# CodeWithSiam

> CodeWithSiam is Siam's portfolio and learning community, featuring Python, data science, machine learning, AI projects, courses, and live learning.

## Main pages

- [Portfolio](https://codewithsiam.vercel.app/): Projects, skills, and background.
- [Courses](https://codewithsiam.vercel.app/course): Project-based Python, data science, and AI learning.
- [Live Learning](https://codewithsiam.vercel.app/live): Live sessions and replays.
- [Community](https://codewithsiam.vercel.app/community/): Community posts and learner discussions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://codewithsiam.vercel.app/privacy): Account and data practices.
- [Terms of Service](https://codewithsiam.vercel.app/terms): Community terms and guidelines.
